paras: Drewes's worm snake (Epacrophis drewesi) is a species of snake in the family Leptotyphlopidae. The species is native to East Africa.
The specific name, drewesi, is in honor of American herpetologist Robert Clifton Drewes.
E. drewesi is endemic to Kenya.
The preferred natural habitat of E. drewesi is shrubland, at an altitude of 1,300 m (4,300 ft).
E. drewesi is nocturnal and fossorial.
